taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-13 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-13
Curve type: A-type (resistivity increasing progressively with depth: ρ1<ρ2<ρ3<ρ4<ρ5)
Aquifer depth: 1.08 – 3.72 m (weathered/fractured zone overlying resistive basement)
Recommendation: Target drilling to approximately 4 m to intersect the moderately resistive weathered/fractured layers (1,340–5,323 Ω·m) as the prospective water-bearing zone; below 4.05 m the resistivity rises sharply above 18,000 Ω·m, indicating competent, low-porosity bedrock, so deeper drilling is unlikely to improve yield and the borehole should be cased through the overburden with the screen set within the 1–3.7 m interval.
